title: CodexOrchestratorEvidence
description: Use complete, self-contained sentences for prose and preserve exact file:line or source_id anchors, symbols, commands, and measured numbers. Omit internal codes, working shorthand, and invented labels. Explicitly disclose skipped checks, unverified claims, and unresolved blockers.

summary.description: State the outcome and its evidence in self-contained sentences. Identify skipped checks and unresolved uncertainty.

items.description: Explain the root cause or design decision in a complete sentence with its relevant conditions.

file.description: Give the exact repository-relative file path. Use the real path in place of any internal label.

symbol.description: Give the exact code symbol as written in the repository, including its qualifier when needed.

what_changed.description: Describe the behavior that changed in a complete sentence.

why.description: Explain why the change was necessary and which requirement it addresses in a complete sentence.

claim.description: State the evidence-backed claim in a complete sentence that stands on its own.

location.description: Give the exact repository-relative file:line anchor and relevant symbol. State explicitly if the location could not be verified.

detail.description: Explain in complete sentences what the cited evidence establishes and where its scope ends.

command.description: Record the exact command that ran, including arguments. Report skipped commands in the field for gaps instead of inventing a run.

key_output.description: State the observed result in a complete sentence, preserving exact measurements or relevant output excerpts.

items.description: Describe each decision, unresolved risk, skipped check, or unverified assumption in a self-contained sentence.
